[[Su]] will test your abilities by having you help her kill the [[Naga]] in [[Raiyan Cave]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = factions
| profession = Necromancer
| primary = y
| secondary = n
}}

===Objectives===
* Speak with [[Su]] again when you are ready to eliminate the Naga.
* Escort Su through the cave and destroy any Naga you find.
* See Su for your reward.

===Early benefits===
* On accepting the quest, Su teaches you the following skills:
**{{skill icon|Barbed Signet}}
**{{skill icon|Soul Feast}}

===Reward===
* 1,500 [[Experience]]
* 100 [[Gold]]
* [[Monastery Credit]]

==Walkthrough==
Follow Su through Raiyan Cave and help kill all the Naga. [[Li Yun]] and [[Soon Kim]], two other necromancer students, will assist you as allies. Be warned, several Naga will cast [[Spirit Rift]], which may be deadly to your party if you do not move out of its range. Also, avoid running ahead and [[Aggro|aggroing]] more Naga than you can handle. In fact, it may be safer to let Su led the way, the better to demonstrate her Powers.

==NPCs==
===Allies===
*{{n}} 5 (20) [[Li Yun]]
*{{n}} 5 (20) [[Soon Kim]]
*{{n}} 10 (20) [[Su]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Su
''So, you passed my brother's test. Well, perhaps you can be of some use to me, then. I need to clear this cave of [[Naga]]. They are little more than pests to someone with my powers, but for you, perhaps they will provide a challenge. In fact, this will be a good test for your abilites.''

:''Take a moment to [[Barbed Signet|review]] [[Soul Feast|the skills]] I am about to give you. Then, [[Su|speak with me]] again once you are ready to test your skills.''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I am happy to be of assistance.
| decline = Perhaps another time.
| ask = You aren't scared a few [[Naga]], are you? They are waiting for you inside the [[Raiyan Cave|cave]].
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
:'''Su''': ''Are you ready to go, finally? The Naga filth must be eliminated. Follow me!''
:'''Li Yun''': ''I think I may be the best student in this class.''
:'''Soon Kim''': ''We will never make it out of here alive. But perhaps that is the point.''

===Reward dialogue===
;Su
''I see the Naga were not much of a challenge for you after all.''
